map.常见纸张等级分类、质量指标及用途对照: Common paper grade classifications, quality indicators and uses
map.📖 查看「纸张等级对照 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Paper Grade Reference'
map.纸张等级对照：按定量（g/m²）、紧度、白度、耐破度与平滑度等指标分级，如胶版纸: Paper grade reference: graded by indicators such as grammage (g/m²), density, brightness, burst strength and smoothness, e.g. offset paper grammage 60 to 120 g/m² and brightness 80% to 90%; the higher the grade the fewer the allowed appearance defects and the higher the strength indicators, so the grade can be matched to the printing method and use.
map.A等（优级品）适合高级印刷；B等（一等品）适合一般印刷；C等（合格品）适合普通用: Grade A (superior) suits high-end printing; Grade B (first grade) suits general printing; Grade C (qualified) suits ordinary uses. Brightness is expressed on the ISO scale (%).
map.印刷选纸、采购比价时，按用途（书刊/包装/食品）在对照表中定位合适等级与关键指标: When selecting paper for printing and comparing prices for procurement, use the reference table to locate the right grade and key indicators by use (book/packaging/food).
map.工艺匹配时，核对定量、白度、挺度、表面强度、不透明度是否达到客户要求。: When checking process compatibility, verify whether grammage, brightness, stiffness, surface strength and opacity meet the customer's requirements.
map.质量争议中，以等级标准对应的指标阈值作为验收依据。: In quality disputes, use the indicator thresholds corresponding to the grade standard as the acceptance basis.
map.示例：书刊印刷如何选纸: Example: choosing paper for book printing
map.在对照表中按『文化用纸→书刊』筛选：常见双胶纸定量 60–120 g/m²，要求: Filter the reference table by 'printing paper → books': common wood-free uncoated paper is 60–120 g/m², requiring opacity≥85% and surface strength adequate for high-speed offset. Choose the specific grade according to the printing method (offset/digital) and the image coverage.
map.示例：关键指标对照口径: Example: how key indicators are organised
map.对照表以『分类—等级—典型定量—核心指标—用途』组织。核对时优先关注与客户合同强: The table is organised as 'category - grade - typical grammage - core indicators - use'. When checking, focus first on the 1-2 indicators strongly tied to the customer contract (e.g. food packaging looks at safety compliance and grammage, posters at brightness and stiffness) to avoid being distracted by irrelevant indicators.
map.纸张等级主要看哪些指标？: Which indicators matter most for paper grade?
map.核心看定量、厚度/紧度、白度、不透明度、挺度、表面强度（拉毛速度）、平滑度。不同: The core ones are grammage, thickness/density, brightness, opacity, stiffness, surface strength (pickup speed) and smoothness. The weights differ by use: books stress opacity and smoothness, packaging stresses stiffness and burst strength, food stresses safety compliance.
map.对照表能替代标准文本吗？: Can the reference table replace the standard text?
map.不能。对照表为快速查阅的概览，验收应以最新国家标准/行业标准的指标阈值与试验方法: No. The table is an overview for quick lookup; acceptance should follow the indicator thresholds and test methods of the latest national/industry standards. The indicators here are common ranges; the formal standards and the contract govern.
